{{Quote|We have about three standard minutes to contact with the enemy. Fire dead ahead, on my mark.''"<br />"''Dead ahead? How unorthodox&hellip; have you considered maneuver?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Vana Dorja]]|<ref name="Destiny's Way" />}}
A '''skirmish''' occurred along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], traveling through [[Yuuzhan Vong]] territory on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] mission to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], was decanted from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] by a Yuuzhan Vong [[dovin basal]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] his [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] while his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and the Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Vana Dorja]] took to its [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]]. Solo developed a new tactic by using the dovin basal's [[Gravity/Legends|gravitic pull]] to slingshot himself around it; the move was later dubbed the [[Solo Slingshot]] and used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in future battles. The ''Falcon''{{'s}} crew destroyed most of the Yuuzhan Vong [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]] that were stationed at the dovin basal, but the enemy was finished off by the arrival of New Republic [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wings]] and [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|clawcraft]].<ref name="Destiny's Way" />
